name: dore-memory
description: Local long-term memory shared by all Claude Code sessions and projects (dore): learns facts, standing rules (trusted once repeated in other words) and updates from plain chat at 0 Claude tokens, ~11 tokens per prompt on average. Runs on this machine; memory never leaves it (only a once-a-day version check to npm for auto-update, off with DORE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1).
